title: Part Sale Log needs permission and shows only this part sale
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user to build the data below. A customer to sell to exists; if none does, create one first: top menu Customers -> New Customer, enter a Name (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and click Save.
  2. A part sale that is not invoiced or paid. Seed it: top menu Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, pick the Customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") and click Save; in the Add Part dialog that opens enter a Description (e.g. "Brake Pads"), Quantity 1 and a Sell Price (e.g. $290.91), then click Save & Close.
  3. A test user WITHOUT Part sales -> Create & Edit: click your initials at the top right -> Settings -> Roles & Permissions -> Create Custom Role -> in Choose a template pick e.g. "Parts Manager" -> Apply; untick Part sales -> Create & Edit (leave Part sales View ticked); Role Name "ZZAUTOTEST No part sale edit" -> Create. Then Settings -> Staff -> on a spare test user's row click the edit icon -> set Role to "ZZAUTOTEST No part sale edit" -> Save & Close; that user logs out and back in. Also create a second part sale the same way, and open any service work order (top menu Work Orders) and make one change on it, so both have entries that must never appear here.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as the user without the permission; open a part sale, open the menu ( ... ) at the top of the parts list and look for Audit Log. (On this build the Audit Log opens as a Part Sale Log panel on the sale's own page, with no separate web address to type, so reaching the log "directly" cannot be done by hand; that part is left to automation.)
  2. In a log you can open, search and confirm no entry from another part sale or a service work order appears.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The user without the permission is not offered Audit Log and is refused if they open the log address directly.
  • The log shows only this sale's entries - never another part sale's or a service work order's.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10265 (Read the part sale log, and a menu that stops putting Delete first); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 4; design canvas boards S4_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N1: “A user who cannot edit part sales is not offered the log, and is refused if they reach its address directly”
  • S4-N2: “The log never shows entries from another part sale or from a service work order”
